finalText:
It builds clean now, exit 0.

The screen of deprecation warnings (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) was just noise from the bump, but two real bugs were hiding under it in the link stage:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes options as `retryCount`. That crashed on `undefined.toFixed(0)`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated any non-boolean flag as an error, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. That threw on the very next line.

Fixed both: `resolveRetries` now reads `retryCount`, and `isBackoffEnabled` treats `undefined` the same as `false` (disabled). Build now finishes with just the 8 harmless deprecation warnings, 0 errors.
